# zxing-wasm 3.1.6

Source: official npm package `zxing-wasm@3.1.6`, https://github.com/Sec-ant/zxing-wasm

Unmodified ES reader/index.js, share.js and reader WASM distribution, with a narrow local TypeScript declaration. MIT license included; ZXing-C++ is Apache-2.0 (https://github.com/zxing-cpp/zxing-cpp), see ZXING-CPP-LICENSE. WASM SHA256: 5003fb4b88c4fbd1fd518a2fd8c8ad365c519e183a08c03a322dddfea3cea84e.

Local assets only. No CDN, image upload, or external identity data processing. Update the JS and WASM together when upgrading.
